# temps_user_role (Resource)

Grants a role to a Temps user. Destroying it removes the role.

Import with `<user_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `users:read`, `users:create`, `users:write`, `users:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_user_role" "ops_admin" {
  user_id   = temps_user.ops.id
  role_type = "admin"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_type` (String) Role name, for example `admin` or `user`.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<user_id>/<id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <user_id>/<role_type>
terraform import temps_user_role.ops_admin 12/admin
```
